# Open a camt.053 or MT940 bank statement and check it adds up

> Free camt.053 and MT940 bank statement reader: see balances and entries as a table, check that opening balance plus entries equals the closing balance, catch duplicates and gaps, and download a CSV. Runs in your browser; the file is never uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
